description: Enumerate every numbering origin consistent with a 'Lys216' in apo(a), and fetch UniProt P08519 domain boundaries to see which origins are defensible; also tabulate the measured apo(a)-plasminogen affinities from PMID 9265615
code:
import requests, json, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
def get(url, **kw):
    for a in range(4):
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, timeout=90, **kw)
            if r.ok: return r
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1.5*(a+1))
    return None

# ---- 1. UniProt P08519 domain/region feature table -------------------------
r = get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P08519.json")
js = r.json()
feats = [f for f in js["features"] if f["type"] in ("Domain","Region","Active site","Disulfide bond","Site")]
dom = [f for f in feats if f["type"]=="Domain"]
print(f"P08519 length {js['sequence']['length']}; {len(dom)} annotated domains")
print("\nLast 5 domains and all non-kringle domains:")
for f in dom[-5:]:
    print(f"   {f['description']:22s} {f['location']['start']['value']}-{f['location']['end']['value']}")
acts = [f for f in feats if f["type"]=="Active site"]
print("\nActive site features on P08519:", acts if acts else "NONE ANNOTATED")

# the Peptidase S1 domain boundary is the only defensible domain-local origin
ps1 = [f for f in dom if "ptidase" in f["description"] or "S1" in f["description"]]
PS1_START = ps1[0]["location"]["start"]["value"] if ps1 else None
PS1_END   = ps1[0]["location"]["end"]["value"] if ps1 else None
print(f"\nUniProt Peptidase S1 domain of P08519: {PS1_START}-{PS1_END}")

SEQ = js["sequence"]["value"]
print(f"UniProt domain-local 216 (start={PS1_START}) = {SEQ[PS1_START-1+215]}{PS1_START+215}")

# ---- 2. Enumerate EVERY origin that would make some lysine 'residue 216' ----
lysdf = pd.read_csv("out/apoa_protease_domain_lysines.csv")
cands = []
for k in lysdf.P08519_abs:
    origin = int(k) - 215
    # what is at that origin, and is it a defensible domain/region boundary?
    near = [f"{f['description']} {f['location']['start']['value']}-{f['location']['end']['value']}"
            for f in dom if abs(f["location"]["start"]["value"] - origin) <= 6]
    cands.append(dict(lysine=f"Lys{k}", implied_origin=origin,
                      residue_at_origin=f"{SEQ[origin-1]}{origin}",
                      domain_starting_within_6aa="; ".join(near) if near else "none"))
cd = pd.DataFrame(cands)
print("\n=== Every numbering origin that would place a lysine at position 216 ===")
print(cd.to_string(index=False))

# ---- 3. Measured apo(a)-plasminogen affinities, PMID 9265615 ---------------
aff = pd.DataFrame([
    dict(species="17K r-apo(a), full",            Kd_nM=20.1,  sd=3.3,   source="PMID 9265615"),
    dict(species="plasma-derived Lp(a)",          Kd_nM=5.58,  sd=0.08,  source="PMID 9265615"),
    dict(species="17K r-apo(a) minus protease",   Kd_nM=3158., sd=138.,  source="PMID 9265615"),
])
aff["fold_vs_17K"] = (aff.Kd_nM/20.1).round(1)
print("\n=== Binding of apo(a) to Glu-plasminogen (PMID 9265615) ===")
print(aff.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nDeleting the protease-like domain weakens plasminogen binding "
      f"{3158/20.1:.0f}-fold (20.1 -> 3158 nM), i.e. dGG = "
      f"{-0.001987*310*np.log(20.1/3158):.2f} kcal/mol at 37 C.")
aff.to_csv("out/apoa_plg_affinity.csv", index=False); cd.to_csv("out/lys216_numbering_candidates.csv", index=False)

# ---- 4. Figure -------------------------------------------------------------
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.3]})
b = ax[0].bar(range(3), aff.Kd_nM, yerr=aff.sd, color=["#2e6f9e","#4c9f70","#c0392b"],
              edgecolor="black", linewidth=.6, capsize=4)
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_ylabel("$K_d$ for Glu-plasminogen (nM, log scale)")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[0].set_xticklabels(["17K\nr-apo(a)","plasma\nLp(a)","17K$\\Delta$P\nno protease dom."], fontsize=9)
for i,(v,s) in enumerate(zip(aff.Kd_nM, aff.sd)):
    ax[0].text(i, v*1.6, f"{v:g}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax[0].annotate("", xy=(2,2600), xytext=(0,26), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="black", lw=1.2))
ax[0].text(1.05, 260, "157-fold\nloss", ha="center", fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold")
ax[0].set_title("A  The apo(a) protease-like domain is a\nplasminogen-binding module (PMID 9265615)", fontsize=10, loc="left")

cd2 = cd.copy()
ok = cd2.domain_starting_within_6aa != "none"
ax[1].barh(range(len(cd2)), [1]*len(cd2),
           color=["#4c9f70" if o else "#d8dde3" for o in ok], edgecolor="black", linewidth=.6)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(cd2)))
ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{l}   origin {o}" for l,o in zip(cd2.lysine, cd2.implied_origin)], fontsize=8.5)
for i,(res,nr) in enumerate(zip(cd2.residue_at_origin, cd2.domain_starting_within_6aa)):
    ax[1].text(.03, i, f"origin = {res};  {nr[:46]}", va="center", fontsize=7.8)
ax[1].set_xticks([]); ax[1].set_xlim(0,1)
ax[1].set_title('B  Numbering origins that would yield a "Lys216"\n'
                "green = coincides with an annotated domain boundary", fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
